hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Lower slips
function: The segmented ring below the element that rides up the lower cone and bites the casing to hold the plug against pressure from above.

tabs.overview: Segments break apart on setting and are driven outward by the cone; carbide buttons or wickers bite the casing wall. The lower set takes the frac load, the upper set holds against pressure from below.
tabs.engineering: Cast iron or ceramic segments with carbide inserts; sized to the casing ID.
tabs.safety: Segments and buttons are the hardened debris left after milling.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
